{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/merge_duplicates.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"Ops script: merge duplicate household records in data/registry.json. Modifies data/registry.json.

Run from the Lifeline root:  python scripts/merge_duplicates.py

One-time cleanup for LIFE-203. Finds groups of active households that are really the
same family (registry.dedup.find_duplicates), keeps the record whose household ID is
valid (core.ids.is_valid_household_id), and marks every other record in the group as
'merged' into the kept record via registry.register.set_status. The kept record and
all other records are left untouched; nothing is deleted.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id  # noqa: E402
from registry.dedup import find_duplicates  # noqa: E402
from registry.register import get_household, load_households, set_status  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    groups = find_duplicates(load_households())
    if not groups:
        print("no duplicate families found")
        return
    for group in groups:
        records = [get_household(hid) for hid in group]
        kept = next((r for r in records if is_valid_household_id(r.id)), records[0])
        print(f"duplicate family group {group}: keeping {kept.id} ({kept.head.name})")
        for other in records:
            if other.id == kept.id:
                continue
            set_status(other.id, "merged", merged_into=kept.id)
            print(f"  merged {other.id} ({other.head.name}) into {kept.id}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"}}
